SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION: OCTOBER 24, 2026
Ginapahibalo sang Negros Power ang mga konsumidores nga may ara sang natalana nga power interruption sa October 24, 2026 (Saturday).
Ini kabahin sang 5-year rehabilitation kag modernization plan sang Negros Power agud malikawan ang mga wala ginalauman kag mas lapnagon nga power interruptions kag mangin reliable ang distribution system sang aton elektrisidad.
Yari ang mga detalye sang scheduled power interruption:
Date: October 24, 2026 (Saturday)
Reason: 
● NGCP Request for Bcd-Reclamation 69kV Line Shutdown to repair damaged overhead line dropper conductor ;
● NEPC Gonzaga Substation Maintenance ;
● Reconductoring of 0.25km along Burgos St. From Central Block Inn to Locsin St. ; 
● Reconductoring of 0.30km along San Juan St. From Burgos St. To BFP ;
●Extension of 0.5 km 3PH Tree Wire from Palanca to Central Block Inn ; and
●69kV Pole Erection along Burgos and Galo St. for New Capitol Line
Time & Affected Areas:
6:00AM to 7:00AM & 5:00PM to 6:00PM
